1. (Currently amended) An endoscopic instrument comprising:an instrument body that comprises at least one flexible section that can be wound in at least one winding; and
a holding device that comprises a gripper for holding the at least one winding that is rotatably supported on the instrument body, the gripper comprising,wherein the gripper has a tube-shaped center part andfrom which a latch extends extending away from and fixedly attached to the tube-shaped center, the latch having a with radial distance to the center part around at least a part of the circumference of the tube-shaped center part and defining a curved holding space that is configured to remain open.
2. (Currently amended) The endoscopic instrument of claim 1, wherein the instrument body further comprises consists of a supply section and a probe section.
3. (Currently amended) The endoscopic instrument of claim 2, wherein the probe section is flexible and can be wound in at least one winding, preferably multiple windings.
4. (Original) The endoscopic instrument of claim 1, wherein the gripper is a one-piece rigid plastic part.
5. (Original) The endoscopic instrument of claim 4, wherein the gripper is arranged on a base and rotatably supported.
6. (Currently amended) The endoscopic instrument of claim 4, wherein the gripper comprises a holding space is configured to receive a for the probe section, and wherein the holding space is curved around the instrument body.
7. (Original) The endoscopic instrument of claim 6, wherein the holding space is longer than one third rotation of the gripper in rotation direction of the gripper.
8. (Original) The endoscopic instrument of claim 4, wherein the gripper comprises at least one latch recess for holding a section of the instrument body.
9. (Original) The endoscopic instrument of claim 5, wherein the base comprises at least one latch recess for holding a section of the instrument body.
10. (Original) The endoscopic instrument of claim 1, wherein the holding device is secured on the instrument body in a non-displaceable manner.
11. (Original) The endoscopic instrument of claim 1, wherein the holding device is undetachably held on the instrument body.
12. (Currently amended) The endoscopic instrument of claim 2 [[1]], wherein the holding device comprises a base configured for attachment to an instrument having a non-round cross- section.
13. (Original) The endoscopic instrument of claim 12, wherein the base surrounds the supply section or the probe section around the whole circumference or alternatively, only around a part of its circumference.
14. (Currently amended) The endoscopic instrument of claim 2 [[1]], wherein the holding device is axially movably arranged on the supply section or the probe section.
15. (Currently amended) An A holding device for an endoscopic instrument, the endoscopic instrument comprising:an instrument body having at least one flexible section configured to be wound in at least one winding;[[,]]a wherein the holding device having;comprises a base towards a proximal end of the instrument,a gripper at a distal location, the gripper for holding the at least one winding, wherein the gripper can be rotatably arranged on the instrument body, and
wherein the gripper comprises a tube-shaped center part from which a latch extends away in radial distance to the center part around at least a part of the circumference of the center part to define a holding space that extends more than a half turn around a center axis of the center part.
